sheet.title: P&IDS PRE-AERATION AND MEMBRANE BIOREACTOR TOWERS
sheet.issue_status: DESIGN/BUILD DOCUMENTS - prepared for submission to EPA in July 2021 to provide a general understanding of the project concept; not intended to reflect design requirements
legend_notes: TYPICAL FOR 2 BLOWERS: the SCADA HMI / MBR PLC I/O rows are drawn once, wired to BLR-100101's panel; the BLR-090101 panel bus and VFD feed end at break symbols
Horizontal bands: SCADA HMI, MBR PLC, MDP-2 (CB 480V feeding VFD-100101)
Each blower sits in a dashed box labelled SOUND ENCLOSURE with a control panel box holding VFD, OIT and signal bubbles
ADDITIONAL SIGNALS AVAILABLE FOR MONITORING: REMOTE, WAIT, OUTLET PRESSURE, INLET TEMPERATURE, OUTLET TEMPERATURE, MOTOR CURRENT, POWER, ERROR CODE AND RUNTIME (printed at both blowers)
Title block title reads TOWERS although the sheet shows the blowers
Process air lines are drawn thin dashed; no line numbers, sizes or valve tags are printed on this sheet
